commands.title: Open Views...
commands.description: Open dialog to select and activate available view configurations

commands.title: Add New View...
commands.description: Create a new custom view configuration with specified layout and preferences

commands.title: Clone View
commands.description: Duplicate the currently active view with all its settings and signal selections

commands.title: Edit View...
commands.description: Modify properties and settings of the currently active view

commands.title: Delete View
commands.description: Permanently remove the currently active view configuration

commands.title: Edit Active Axis...
commands.description: Configure the active axis properties and settings

commands.title: Add New Cursor...
commands.description: Create a new measurement cursor for the active view to mark specific time positions

commands.title: Edit Active Cursor...
commands.description: Modify properties such as position, color, and label of the currently active cursor

commands.title: Delete Active Cursor
commands.description: Remove the currently active cursor from the view

commands.title: Delete Other Cursor
commands.description: Remove all but not the currently active cursor from the view

commands.title: Show Cursor
commands.description: Scroll the view to make the cursor visible

commands.title: Activate Cursor
commands.description: Set the specified cursor as the active cursor for navigation and editing

commands.title: Goto
commands.description: Navigate to a specific position in the signal data timeline

commands.title: Set Color
commands.description: Change the visual color of the selected cursor

commands.title: Set Color
commands.description: Change the visual color of the selected plot or signal trace

commands.title: Load/Re-Load
commands.description: Load signal record data from source, or reload to refresh cached data

commands.title: Un-Load
commands.description: Unload signal record data from memory to free resources

commands.title: Compare with impulse Viewer
commands.description: Open the impulse Diff Viewer to compare two signal records side-by-side

commands.title: Re-Load
commands.description: Reload the signal record data from the source, discarding cached data

commands.title: Edit reader
commands.description: Open dialog to modify the configuration of the active signal reader

commands.title: Edit reader configuration
commands.description: Modify advanced configuration parameters for the active reader instance

commands.title: Run/Stop
commands.description: Start or stop data acquisition from the active record source

commands.title: Continue/Pause
commands.description: Continue or pause data acquisition without stopping the record source

commands.title: Append to Active View
commands.description: Appends the selected scopes or signal to the currently active view

commands.title: Zoom In
commands.description: Increase magnification of the time axis to show more detail, centered on the active cursor position. Additional navigation: Use Ctrl+Mouse Wheel Down to zoom in centered on mouse pointer location, or Ctrl+Left Mouse Button drag to select and zoom into a specific range.

commands.title: Zoom Out
commands.description: Decrease magnification of the time axis to show wider time range, centered on the active cursor position. Additional navigation: Use Ctrl+Mouse Wheel Up to zoom out centered on mouse pointer location.

commands.title: Zoom Fit
commands.description: Automatically adjust zoom level to fit all visible signal data in the view. Additional navigation: Mouse wheel with Shift scrolls the view horizontally.

commands.title: Set Value Axis
commands.description: Configure the vertical axis range for analog signal display

commands.title: Show Cursor Details
commands.description: Toggle visibility of the cursor details panel showing measurements and timing information

commands.title: Show Record Area
commands.description: Toggle visibility of the record management area in the viewer

commands.title: Splits the view area vertically
commands.description: Splits the view area vertically, dividing the viewing space into left and right sections to display multiple views side by side

commands.title: Splits the view tree horizontally
commands.description: Splits the view tree horizontally, dividing the viewing space into top and bottom sections to display multiple views stacked vertically

commands.title: Show Names Right Aligned
commands.description: Align signal names to the right side of the name column

commands.title: Show Icons
commands.description: Display signal icons next to signal names

commands.title: Show Value Column
commands.description: Display the active value column showing signal values at cursor position

commands.title: Show Axis
commands.description: Display the domain axis (time, sample index, etc.) at the bottom of the viewer

commands.title: Show Grid
commands.description: Display background grid lines aligned with axis major ticks for easier value reading

commands.title: Fit Vertical
commands.description: Automatically adjust row heights to fit all visible diagrams within the viewer height

commands.title: Show Sticky Parents
commands.description: Displays sticky parents in the tree view, keeping parent nodes visible while scrolling through child elements for better navigation context

commands.title: Add Port
commands.description: Create a new signal port connection to import data from external sources

commands.title: Edit Port
commands.description: Modify configuration settings for the selected port

commands.title: Open Port
commands.description: Activate and open the selected port for data reception

commands.title: Reset Port Preferences
commands.description: Restore port configuration to default settings

commands.title: Store Port Preferences
commands.description: Save current port configuration and preferences for future sessions

commands.title: Single / Multiple
commands.description: Toggle between single-port and multiple-port iteration mode

commands.title: Enable/Disable Updating
commands.description: Enable or disable automatic updating of port data from sources

commands.title: Show in text editor...
commands.description: Open the selected element in an external text editor for viewing or editing

commands.title: Un-page signal data
commands.description: Load all paged signal data into memory for faster access and analysis

commands.title: Open Preferences...
commands.description: Open the preferences dialog to configure application-wide settings

commands.title: Report issue or proposal
commands.description: Open dialog to submit bug reports, feature requests, or improvement proposals

commands.title: Open help
commands.description: Open help browser

commands.title: Enable Groups
commands.description: Enable hierarchical group presentation for organizing related signals together

commands.title: Re-fresh
commands.description: Update the display to reflect any changes in underlying signal data

commands.title: Go Into
commands.description: Navigate into the selected folder to show only its contained signals

commands.title: Go Up
commands.description: Navigate up one level in the signal hierarchy
